Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms, 12 nurses. Open weekdays 08:00–19:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00. Accredited April 2022; expires April 2027 — renewal needs infection-control audit. Attendance ~180/day (peak 310, Jan 2025 flu wave); no-shows 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Two incidents: March 2024 fridge failure (€2,100 lost) — now networked alarm plus paper log; November 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote an allergy field — records now lock when open.

Rules: no renewal without a consultation in 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions over 8°C reported same day to the regional agency.

Second ultrasound postponed pending a utilisation study (not done). Nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025; covered rotationally, unsustainable past winter.
